description: Auto-seed flashcards from incorrect questions in PracticeAttempt data. When the seeding runs (via runSeedsIfNeeded), also generate flashcards for every incorrectly-answered question across all 5 subjects. This gives users an immediate deck of 300+ flashcards to study from day one, using the SM-2 spaced repetition system already built.
steps: Create src/features/flashcards/utils/seed-flashcards.ts. This function: (1) reads all PracticeAttempts from localStorage via getAllAttempts(), (2) collects all questionIds where correct===false, (3) loads the full question set via loadAllQuestions(), (4) for each incorrect question, creates a Flashcard with front=questionText, back=correct answer label + text + explanation, subject, topic, state='new', easeFactor=2.5, interval=0, repetitions=0, nextReview=now, lastReview=null. (5) Deduplicates against existing flashcards by id pattern 'fc-{questionId}'. (6) Saves the merged array via saveFlashcards().

Wire the seed-flashcards function into the seed guard. In both src/features/dashboard/components/dashboard-content.tsx and src/features/question-bank/components/attempts-list-client.tsx and recent-attempts-section.tsx, import seedFlashcardsFromAttempts and add it to the runSeedsIfNeeded array AFTER the attempt seed functions (so attempts exist when flashcard seeding runs).
Update the SEED_VERSION_KEY in seed-guard.ts from 'cfa-buddy-seeded-v5' to 'cfa-buddy-seeded-v6' so existing users get the new flashcard data on next page load.
Run bun run tsc --noEmit to verify no type errors.
acceptance_criteria: A new file src/features/flashcards/utils/seed-flashcards.ts exists and exports a seedFlashcardsFromAttempts function
After seeding, localStorage 'cfa-buddy-flashcards' contains flashcards for all incorrect questions from the attempt data (expected ~316 cards: 1283 - 967 correct = 316 incorrect)
Flashcard deck shows cards with real CFA question content on the front and explanations on the back
verification: Run: bun run tsc --noEmit - expect exit 0
Run: bun run vitest --run - expect same or better pass count
findings: Implementation complete. bun run tsc --noEmit passes cleanly. All 261 tests pass (2 pre-existing env.test.ts failures are the known zod v4 issue). The seed-flashcards function is placed after attempt seeds in the array so attempts exist when flashcard seeding runs. Seed version bumped to v6.
